translations.web: Everyone who passes over to those who are counted, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the offering to Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Everyone twenty years of age or older who crosses over must give this offering to the LORD.
translations.kjv: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering unto the LORD.
translations.asv: Every one that passeth over unto them that are numbered, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the offering of Jehovah.
